commit.message:
Mac ARM64 3P support: OpenImageIO and OpenColorIO (#339)

* Updated build_openimageio.py to support darwin-arm64
* Added `mcpp-2.7.2_az.2-rev1-mac-arm64` into
package_build_list_host_darwin-arm64.json`
* Added patches to fix compile errors with BOOST 1.76.0 due to updated
clang-17
  * clang16_mac_boost_container_hash.patch
  * clang16_mac_boost_numeric.patch
* Added necessary `-DBUILD_FMT_FORCE=ON` to cmake command for
OpenImageIO

Signed-off-by: Steve Pham <82231385+spham-amzn@users.noreply.github.com>
